basic_info.description: Are you contemplating homeownership in San Francisco? If so, this fixer-upper presents an exceptional opportunity to build sweat equity. The property is primed for transformation and offers significant potential.  The upper unit features two bedrooms and one bathroom, while the lower unit includes the garage, one bedroom, one bathroom, and additional kitchen. This residence is ideal for first-time homebuyers or investors willing to update or expand upon the existing structure and give it the renovation it deserves. With a rich family history spanning over 50 years, the home is ready for its next chapter. Don't miss the chance to become a long-term neighbor on one of the finest streets in San Francisco.
